summary: United Natural Foods, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a Term Loan Amendment entered on June 18, 2026. The amendment reprices approximately $371 million outstanding term loan, reducing the applicable margin over SOFR from 4.75% to 4.00%. The Co-Borrowers include SUPERVALU INC., UNFI Wholesale, Inc., and UNFI Distribution Company, LLC. JPMorgan Chase Bank serves as administrative and collateral agent. No board recommendation or advisor is named. All other material terms remain unchanged. This is a routine debt repricing, not a special situation. Watch for potential future refinancing or leverage changes.
